newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials rangebound in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials rangebound in early trade.

text.p: The Dow Industrials were rangebound in early trading on Thursday, failing to take a cue from a higher bond market.
Some high-technology stocks showed strength, including Intel Corp.
The Dow Jones industrial average was off one at 5,992 but the NASDAQ Index was up four at 1,210. The S&P Index was off fractionally at 701.
The long bond was up 9/32 to yield 6.68 percent.
